correctness.rationale: The original mathematical statements hold. In the repaired proof set h=i⊕c(u) for a true bipartition c of G. Every prism edge flips h, so vertices in different new layers cannot share a neighbor. In a fixed new layer the prism neighbors of the representative of u project bijectively to the closed neighborhood N_G[u] in the other layer (the vertical edge supplies u). For distinct u,v these projected sets intersect exactly at distance at most two. This proves the graph isomorphism without degree or connectedness assumptions, including isolated base vertices. Open packings are independent sets in that graph, restricting to either copy independently. A face is maximal exactly when both restrictions are maximal, which proves both exact polynomial squares. The generic coloring correspondence gives the claimed coloring corollary. For P_n the index shift s_i−2(i−1) proves the all-set count for k≥1, with the empty term separately. Maximal distance-three packings must cover the entire path with closed radius-two neighborhoods, and conversely. This gives end offsets 0–2, internal spacings 3–5, and the exact numerator and denominator in the length-by-cardinality series; for each k≥1 precisely the lengths 3k−2 to 5k can arise. The ladder sizes are the sumset of two copies of the resulting path size interval. Purity is accordingly equivalent to path-square well-coveredness, with equality of the endpoints exactly for n=1,2,3,6. The argument is a full all-order proof under the original hypotheses. The checker and recorded coverage in VERIFICATION.md were inspected, not executed; its own brute-force counts are bounded. Corrected RESULT.md, SLOGAN.txt and METADATA.json retain these valid calculations, explicitly narrow the contribution, and leave the verification channels unchanged.

evidence: Theorem 2.2 concerns the maximum number of vertices; it transforms an optimum packing to a fiber-doubled one, using only enough control for a cardinality bound. It does not encode both free packing choices.
Krapivsky–Luck already give the finite open-chain formula for general blockade range; range two directly contains q_n(z). This is stronger coverage of the path factor, not a Cartesian-prism theorem.

The same-day Resultary theorem concerns a collapse of the ordinary open neighborhood complex to a double-cover spine, under a four-cycle-free restriction. The original neighborhood complex's one-skeleton does capture the common-neighbor graph, but homotopy or the spine does not determine that original one-skeleton, and the statement does not supply the arbitrary-bipartite two-square theorem.
Generic two-step-graph coloring and independence correspondences are prior; the Song–Yue abstract identifies Cartesian products but its specific theorems could not be checked.

originality.rationale: PASS applies to the repaired claim only. The original title and finding prominently foregrounded the exceptional purity classification without crediting the exact prior path-square classification, and the maximal path factor and its cardinality support were already covered by a stronger open-chain enumeration. Neither is accepted as a new mathematical contribution. The repaired publication files credit both sources and retain the graph-level two-copy decomposition and full- and maximal-set transfer for arbitrary bipartite bases. The strongest accessible prism precedent proves a scalar optimum by a different, nonbijective map; the earlier explicit cycle decomposition covers even-cycle bases but not arbitrary bipartite G. No distinct covering source for the retained general decomposition was verified. The ladder formulas are applications; scalar colors and path factors are not separately claimed as new.
residual_risks: A covering extended-double-cover or half-square theorem may be indexed under different terminology; the attempted external alias lookup was unavailable and is not negative evidence.
Song–Yue full text was not inspected; an already-known coloring consequence remains possible and has no separate priority claim.
The retained decomposition is accepted on the bounded documented comparison, not as a historical-priority guarantee.

value.rationale: The repaired core upgrades a natural and previously studied maximum-packing question to the entire simplicial complex for every bipartite base. In a single structural certificate it separates independently chosen feasible sets and independently chosen maximal sets and gives exact coefficientwise transfer even for disconnected bases. This is useful beyond the previously enumerated path and cycle examples: equality of extremal packing numbers cannot determine any of these maximal-face structures. The ladder is an explicit illustration of what the transfer computes, not the value basis for a new purity theorem or a new one-dimensional count.
